title: Clinch Pummeling
description:
1. With a trained partner chest-to-chest, keep the forehead upright, elbows close, and one arm inside as an underhook.
2. Swim the outside arm beneath the partner's arm to gain the next underhook while both partners take short balanced steps.
3. Alternate sides without squeezing the neck or twisting the shoulders, then disengage and reset cleanly.
